display.purpose: The bottom-anchored rotating hero line only, in Google Sans Variable.

headline.purpose: Chapter titles, in Playfair Display. Nothing smaller takes the serif.

title.purpose: Card and sub-chapter headings such as a rank card's Highest.

body.purpose: Chapter descriptions, captions, and supporting prose.

label.purpose: Control labels, table column heads, legend and strip headings.

meta.purpose: The uppercase mono date-range line set below the hero paragraph.

data.purpose: Every figure on the page, monospaced with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: hero-frame
shadows.purpose: Grounds the full-viewport film frame against the page.

shadows.name: hero-action-rest
shadows.purpose: Keeps hero actions and the floating back-to-top ring legible over moving imagery.

shadows.name: hero-action-hover
shadows.purpose: The Living Green bloom around hero actions on hover.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Floats the country combobox list above the sections that follow it.

shadows.name: switch-thumb
shadows.purpose: Raises the selected option of a segmented control.

motion.name: ease-atlas
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every state change on the page.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Resolves hero copy and actions upward; the two title beats follow at 180ms and 320ms.

motion.name: control-focus
motion.purpose: Lifts and accents a focused country control by 2px.

motion.name: combo-open
motion.purpose: Scales and rises the country list open, flipping origin when it opens upward.

motion.name: rank-fill
motion.purpose: Grows a rank bar to its new share of the shared scale.

motion.name: rank-reorder
motion.purpose: Moves a reused rank row to its new position; entry animates over 420ms.

motion.name: table-row
motion.purpose: Softens the background change on comparison-table row hover.

motion.name: year-playback-step
motion.purpose: Advances the synchronized year playback cadence.

components.name: Play Button
components.description: The primary action on the page: steps the shared year forward every 650ms.
components.css: .ds-btn-play { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; min-width:76px; padding:9px 16px; border:none; border-radius:8px; background:var(--action-accent, oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.8)); color:#071018; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-play svg { width:12px; height:12px; } .ds-btn-play:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-play:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.8)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-play:disabled { opacity:0.55; cursor:wait; }

components.name: Hero Action
components.description: Pill anchor over the hero video; Explore the atlas always precedes Donate.
components.html: Explore the atlas
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:48px; padding:12px 28px; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.45); border-radius:9999px; background:#000; color:#fff; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 12px 30px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7); transition:transform 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-hero svg { width:16px; height:16px; transition:transform 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-hero:hover { transform:scale(1.05); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.36), 0 0 28px oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.48), 0 18px 44px -14px oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.62); } .ds-btn-hero:hover svg { transform:translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Metric Select
components.description: Labelled native select used for every metric picker; its label is an uppercase technical label.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; min-width:0; } .ds-field-label { font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.03em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-muted,#686660); } .ds-select { max-width:220px; padding:7px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface-2,#f2f1ec); color:var(--text-primary,#0b0b0b); font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13.5px; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.8)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Country Search
components.description: Editable combobox over 217 countries; replaced a 217-option native select.
components.css: .ds-combo { position:relative; min-width:0; } .ds-combo-icon { position:absolute; top:50%; left:12px; width:16px; height:16px; transform:translateY(-50%); color:var(--text-muted,#686660); pointer-events:none; } .ds-combo-input { width:100%; min-height:40px; padding:9px 36px; border:1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface,#fcfcfb); color:var(--text-primary,#0b0b0b); font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; transition:border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-combo-input::placeholder { color:var(--text-muted,#686660); } .ds-combo-input:hover { border-color:var(--axis,#c3c2b7); } .ds-combo-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.8)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: Two-option switch built from native radios; used for Level/Change and Percent/Amount.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:3px; padding:3px; border:1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius:10px; background:var(--bg,#f9f9f7); } .ds-segmented label { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:36px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:7px; color:var(--text-secondary,#52514e); font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-segmented input { position:absolute; inset:0; margin:0; opacity:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-segmented label:has(:checked) { background:var(--surface,#fcfcfb); color:var(--text-primary,#0b0b0b); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06), 0 3px 8px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-segmented label:has(:focus-visible) { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(75% 0.25 145 / 0.8)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Analytical Card
components.description: The flat, hairlined surface card that holds a plot stage or a ranked list.
components.html:
Highest

213 countries reporting · 2024

Content sits on a flat surface; depth comes from tone and a single hairline.
components.css: .ds-card { min-width:0; padding:20px; border:1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface,#fcfcfb); font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--text-primary,#0b0b0b); } .ds-card-head { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:4px 12px; margin-bottom:12px; padding-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); } .ds-card-title { margin:0; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; } .ds-card-meta { margin:0; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-muted,#686660); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-card-body { margin:0; font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--text-secondary,#52514e); }

components.name: Ranked List Row
components.description: The signature row: the bar is the row's own ground behind the rank numeral and name, and stops short of the value.
components.html:
1. 3United States13.8 t
  2. 4Australia9.1 t
components.css: .ds-rank-list { display:grid; gap:2px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-rank-row { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.6rem minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:8px; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--text-primary,#0b0b0b); } .ds-rank-bar { grid-area:1 / 1 / 2 / 3; align-self:stretch; margin-block:-4px; z-index:0; overflow:hidden; border-radius:5px; background:var(--rank-track,#f1f1ed); pointer-events:none; } .ds-rank-fill { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; transform-origin:left; transform:scaleX(var(--ds-ratio,1)); background:var(--ds-fill,transparent); transition:transform 460ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rank-num { grid-area:1 / 1 / 2 / 2; z-index:1; text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-rank-name { grid-area:1 / 2 / 2 / 3; z-index:1; display:flex; min-width:0; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-weight:600; } .ds-rank-label { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-swatch { width:11px; height:11px; flex-shrink:0; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--surface,#fcfcfb); } .ds-rank-value { grid-area:1 / 3 / 2 / 4; flex-shrink:0; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:13px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Field Toolbar
components.description: The recessed well that carries a chapter's pickers and the shared year readout.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding:16px 20px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface-2,#f2f1ec); font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar-label { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--text-muted,#686660); } .ds-toolbar-value { font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text-primary,#0b0b0b); }

components.name: Chapter Heading
components.description: The serif plate title with its supporting column and closing hairline that opens every chapter.
components.html:
The Rankings

The two ends of the same distribution, side by side: who leads, who trails, and who has travelled furthest since 1990.
components.css: .ds-chapter { display:grid; gap:12px; padding-bottom:28px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, rgba(11,11,11,0.10)); } @media (min-width:1024px) { .ds-chapter { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(260px,0.65fr); align-items:end; gap:48px; } } .ds-chapter-title { margin:0; max-width:18ch; font-family:'Playfair Display Variable','Playfair Display',Georgia,serif; font-size:clamp(30px,4.2vw,50px); font-weight:600; line-height:1.06; letter-spacing:-0.015em; text-wrap:balance; color:var(--text-primary,#0b0b0b); } .ds-chapter-desc { margin:0; max-width:62ch; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--text-secondary,#52514e); }

narrative.overview:
The system pairs the authority of a printed reference atlas with the immediacy of a living climate record. A framed, full-viewport filmic hero establishes scale and urgency; everything below it becomes quieter, flatter, and more exact so the data can carry the argument. The page is one long reading, divided into chapters by hairlines and air rather than by boxes.

Type does the register change. The hero speaks in a wide geometric sans set very tight and very large; chapter titles speak in a serif display face (Playfair Display) that reads as a printed atlas plate; everything operational — labels, controls, notes — is IBM Plex Sans, and every figure is IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals so columns of numbers line up and never jitter as the year advances. Light mode is warm paper and ink; dark mode is graphite with illuminated plotting marks. Neither mode introduces a second brand palette.

Colour is almost entirely functional. Three country hues (blue, orange, green) hold their slot across every view; everything else is grey context. Saturated colour beyond those three exists only to encode magnitude, direction, action, or focus. The Rankings chapter extended this with its own measured colour rung — bars that are large filled shapes and carry text on top of them — but it did not extend the world's identity.
keyCharacteristics: Immersive framed motion at the opening, followed by restrained analytical chapters.
Serif display chapter titles over a sans body; monospaced tabular numerals for all figures.
Warm paper light surfaces and near-black graphite dark surfaces, separated by 1px hairlines.
Blue, orange, green country series that stay synchronized across map, table, bubbles, trends, and ranks.
Flat, bordered controls and plot stages; depth reserved for the hero, popovers, and the switch thumb.
Every encoding readable without colour: rank numerals, arrow glyphs, signs, and labelled legend bands.

rules.name: The Three-Country Rule
rules.body: Blue is always country one, orange country two, green country three. Never reorder or repurpose these hues within a view.

rules.name: The Quiet Field Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces and hairlines carry structure. Saturated colour must encode action, selection, magnitude, direction, or focus — never decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Light and dark preserve semantic roles and relative contrast; they do not introduce a separate brand palette. Any new token lands in all three theme blocks (:root, the prefers-color-scheme: dark media block, and :root[data-theme="dark"]) in the same commit.

rules.name: The Legible Bar Rule
rules.body: A colour that is both a large filled region and the ground under a label belongs to the rank-* rung, not to band-* or the series accents. The map ramp and chart series are tuned for filled regions with no text on them and cannot hold 3:1 against the card and 4.5:1 under a label at the same time; the rank-* values were tuned by measurement into that narrow band (measured 3.47–3.56 against the card light, 3.43–3.55 dark; labels 5.39–5.53 light, 4.90–5.08 dark). Repainting rank bars with --band-* to "simplify the palette" reintroduces a contrast failure that will not be visible in a screenshot.

rules.name: The Data Has a Different Voice Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums for years, measures, and compact technical metadata; prose, labels, and navigation stay in IBM Plex Sans. A number that animates must be tabular or it will jitter.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Large editorial headings use heavy weight, compact line height, and negative tracking. Do not imitate that density in body copy.

rules.name: The Plate Title Rule
rules.body: The serif belongs to chapter titles only. Card titles, labels, and values never take Playfair; a sub-heading that wants more presence gets weight, not a face change.

rules.name: The Open Chapter Rule
rules.body: Section spacing and hairlines define the story. Cards wrap controls, tables, and plots — never a whole chapter.

rules.name: The Pinned Context Rule
rules.body: When a data region must scroll horizontally, keep the identifying label visible and give small screens a plain-language scroll hint.

rules.name: The Cinematic Exception Rule
rules.body: Ambient shadow belongs to the hero, its over-video actions, floating overlays, and the switch thumb. Analytical surfaces use tone and hairlines instead.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: The larger outer surface takes the larger radius; inner controls step down so the layering stays visually ordered.

dos: Do keep blue, orange, and green in slot order across controls, table, map, bubbles, trends, and ranks.
Do define every new colour token in all three theme blocks in the same change, and state its measured contrast against the surface it will sit on.
Do use rank-* for any bar, chip, or block that will have text sitting on top of it.
Do pair monospaced tabular numerals with plain-language labels and units.
Do carry direction with shape (arrow, sign, rank numeral) as well as colour, so a figure survives without hue.
Do keep every interactive target at 44px or larger under @media (pointer: coarse) while leaving its visual box alone.
Do disable transitions, entry animations, and the hero video under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep chapters open: hairlines and spacing, not nested boxes.
donts: Don't repaint rank bars with --band-* or the --accent* series; see the Legible Bar Rule.
Don't add ambient shadow to analytical cards, tables, toolbars, or plot stages. Shadow is for the hero, floating overlays, and the switch thumb.
Don't use decorative colour that could be mistaken for a series, a magnitude band, a selection, or a focus state.
Don't mute text that sits on a coloured bar to create hierarchy; change size or weight instead.
Don't set Playfair on anything smaller than a chapter title, and don't substitute a system serif or system display face for it.
Don't hand Plotly an oklch() value — it cannot parse it and silently swaps in its own scale.
Don't build a segmented control, disclosure, or listbox out of divs when a native radio, details, or option would carry the keyboard and screen-reader behaviour.
Don't let any region force horizontal scroll at 390px; the comparison table's own scroll frame is the single sanctioned exception.
